headline: Capacity expansion to drive growth

highlights: SII IN reported a modest top-line growth of 9.1% due to capacity constraints and festive shift while operational performance was weak with EBITDA margin of 10.3% (PLe 11.5%) amid stiff competition and persistent RM inflation.
Led by capacity expansion we expect topline CAGR of 13% over the next 3 years with EBITDA margin of 12.0%/13.2%/13.4% in FY27E/FY28E/FY29E respectively.
We have realigned our target multiple amid growth and margin reset the business is witnessing amid excessive price wars.
Revenue increased 9.1% YoY: Top line increased 9.1% YoY to INR5,822mn (PLe INR5,922mn) as against INR5,336mn in 2QFY26.
